# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the tasks you measurably broke/fixed, plus the ones whose move was too small to resolve) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — code guards for baggage + cancellation, plus prompt rules for transfer/passenger/communication
- Changes I made:
  - tools.py `book_reservation` + `update_reservation_baggages`: recompute `nonfree_baggages = max(0, total_baggages − free_allowance)` in-body from membership+cabin+npax (cluster: paid-bag miscount, tasks 17/22).
  - tools.py `_free_checked_bag_allowance` helper encoding the policy allowance table + param-doc rewrite (weak-reader knowledge).
  - tools.py `cancel_reservation`: eligibility guard — raise if a flight is flown (transfer) or if NONE of {booked ≤24h, airline-cancelled flight, business cabin, has insurance} (cluster: ineligible cancel, task 37/IFOYYZ).
  - policy.md: (a) use `calculate` for every shown amount + read exact charge/refund from returned payment_history (tasks 11t1/12/23); (b) transfer LAST after finishing other doable requests, and policy-denied ≠ transfer (tasks 11t0/37); (c) add/remove passenger → DENY not transfer, keep passenger count, worked example (tasks 11/17/22).
- Expected effect + why safe: baggage recompute always equals the gold formula → can only match/no-op (verified YAX4DR/passing-12 unchanged). Cancel guard verified on real DB: BLOCKs IFOYYZ (37, wrong write) but ALLOWs Z7GOZK (passing 19, insurance) and K1NW8N (23, ≤24h) — the only passing task in the cancel class (19) is preserved. Prompt edits are additive knowledge/narrowing; no passing task transfers, changes passenger count, or relies on mental-math.
- Building on prior RESULTS: none (first iteration).
- Refuted hypotheses: none yet.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: multi-intent tasks where the user-sim ends early (17/22 execute only part) and "book same flight as my other reservation" (8/25 — needs matching the source reservation's route/flight, and in 25 the user-sim supplied a conflicting route). No safe general tool designed yet.
- Plateau signal: n/a (first iteration).
- Focus next iteration: if accepted, target the "book-a-copy-of-existing-reservation" cluster (8/25) — consider a composite tool that clones a reservation's flights/route by id — and the early-stop multi-intent completion. If rejected, inspect which of the 3 code/3 prompt edits the RESULT attributes regression to and keep the baggage recompute (lowest risk).

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.450 Δ=+0.200 · fixed={11, 37} · broke={—} · unresolved={12, 23, 25, 8} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — NOT evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them).

Not about the capability — about HOW this run is searching for it: which strategies/edit classes/algorithms are helping vs stalling, and what to try next iteration. Update at the end of the run at minimum; sooner if a plateau or a clear strategy shift is worth recording now. Structure each addition as:

    ## Iteration <id> (or 'run so far')
    - Strategy tried, and whether it moved val (cite LEDGER rows):
    - Plateau/stall signal, if any, and the lever switched to:
    - What to try next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 (run so far)
- Strategy tried: broad first pass — 3 code edits (baggage recompute ×2 tools, cancel eligibility guard) + 3 additive prompt rules, chosen from distinct clusters. Verified every guard against the REAL tau2 DB (loaded via `/vol/home/skillberry/.cache/capevolve-ci/venv`) on the exact reservation ids in the traces, so SAFE checks are data-backed rather than argued.
- Key process win: the run venv + `FlightDB.load(AIRLINE_DB_PATH)` lets you execute the actual tool bodies on real reservations before shipping — use this every iteration to prove a guard fires on the failing id and NOT on the passing id (task 19/Z7GOZK is the sole passing cancel; task 12/YAX4DR the sole passing baggage).
- Correctness-bounded overrides (recompute a value the policy fully determines, e.g. nonfree_baggages) are the safest high-leverage edit here: they equal gold by construction, so they cannot regress a passing task.
- What to try next iteration: composite "clone existing reservation" write tool for the 8/25 cluster; measure whether the calculate/communication prose actually moved 11/12/23 (if RESULT shows no movement, escalate to enriching the write-tool RETURN with an explicit charge/refund field rather than relying on prose).

# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

First iteration on the seed (tau2 airline defaults). Edited BOTH tools.py (code guards) and policy.md (additive prose). All guards were run against the REAL tau2 DB before keeping.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Paid-bag miscount | 17, 22 (+ any book/bag) | agent computes `nonfree_baggages` wrong (ignores free allowance), corrupting the write | BEHAVIORAL/CAPABILITY | in-body computation in 2 tools |
| 2 | Miscommunicated totals/refunds | 11(t1), 12, 23 | agent does mental math for prices/refunds and states a wrong number → COMMUNICATE check fails | KNOWLEDGE/skill | prompt: use `calculate`, read `payment_history` |
| 3 | Wrong transfer / abandons other requests | 11(t0), 37 | transfers on a policy-denied request, or transfers before finishing other doable actions; conversation ends | BEHAVIORAL/DECISION | prompt: deny≠transfer; transfer LAST |
| 4 | Passenger add/remove mishandled | 11, 17, 22 | agent transfers or duplicates passengers when count-change requested | KNOWLEDGE | prompt rule + worked example |
| 5 | Cancels ineligible reservation | 37 (IFOYYZ) | tau2 API doesn't enforce cancel rules; agent cancels a non-eligible booking → extra/wrong write | RULE VIOLATION | in-body eligibility guard |
| — | SKIPPED 40 | 40 | flagged infra noise (user-sim leaked reasoning) — instructed not to optimize against | — | — |
| — | SKIPPED 8, 25 | 8, 25 | "book same flight as before" needs task-specific matching / user-sim gave conflicting route; no safe GENERAL fix | — | — |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | in-body computation | tools.py `book_reservation` | recompute `nonfree_baggages = max(0, total - free_allowance)` from membership+cabin+npax | YES — always policy-correct = gold; task 12/YAX4DR stays nonfree=0 |
| 1 | in-body computation | tools.py `update_reservation_baggages` | same recompute using reservation.cabin/passengers | YES — verified YAX4DR unchanged |
| 1 | helper + doc | tools.py `_free_checked_bag_allowance` + param docs | encodes policy allowance table; docs tell weak reader nonfree is auto-derived | n/a |
| 5 | discriminating guard | tools.py `cancel_reservation` | block if flown (transfer) or none of {≤24h, airline-cancelled, business, insurance} | YES — task 19/Z7GOZK (insurance) still ALLOW; task 23/K1NW8N (≤24h) still ALLOW |
| 2 | prompt (knowledge) | policy.md | use `calculate` for any shown amount; read exact charge/refund from returned payment_history; worked example | YES — task 19 already states exact refund; rule reinforces |
| 3 | prompt (decision-narrowing) | policy.md | transfer LAST after finishing other requests; policy-denied ≠ transfer | YES — no passing task transfers |
| 4 | prompt + example | policy.md | add/remove passenger → DENY (not transfer); keep passenger count; worked example | YES — no passing task changes passenger count |

## Verify-the-fix (ran against the real tau2 DB)
- BAG UM3OG5 (task 17): agent's total=3,nonfree=3 → tool recomputes nonfree=**0** (gold econ 2pax, free=6). Fixes wrong $150 charge.
- BAG YAX4DR (passing task 12/t0): total=2,nonfree=0 → recompute **0** — unchanged, no regression.
- BOOK gold econ 1pax total=3 → nonfree=**0** end-to-end (no crash).
- CANCEL IFOYYZ (task 37 wrong cancel): guard **BLOCKs** (basic_econ, >24h, no ins, not business, not airline-cancelled).
- CANCEL Z7GOZK (passing task 19): guard **ALLOWs** (insurance=yes) — no regression.
- CANCEL K1NW8N (task 23): guard **ALLOWs** (booked 2024-05-14 16:03, within 24h of 2024-05-15 15:00) — not blocked.
- CANCEL NQNU5R: guard **BLOCKs**-flown (landed) — matches policy transfer path.
- tools.py compiles; all write tools present/registered.

## Process & features used
- Serial (single agent). Loaded the real tau2 DB via the run venv and simulated each guard on the exact reservation ids from the failing/passing traces — no speculative guards.
- Prior iterations: none (first iteration; RUNMAP/LEDGER empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- Cancel guard's insurance=yes and ≤24h branches — they are exactly what keep task 19 and task 23 cancellable. Do not tighten them without re-checking those two.
- Baggage recompute is correctness-bounded (equals gold) — keep it; do not re-expose a raw nonfree the agent can miscount.

## Deliberately skipped
- Task 40: infra noise (instructed). Task 8/25: "book the same flight as X" — needs task-specific flight matching / user-sim gave a conflicting route; no general, safe guard. Did NOT add a `reason` param to cancel (would change task 19's passing byte-identical call → regression risk); the objective-state guard covers the failing case without it.

"""tau2-bench adapter template — optimize the airline agent's POLICY + TOOLS.

Ready-to-use cap-evolve adapter for tau2-bench (https://github.com/sierra-research/tau2-bench).
Supports ANY litellm-compatible provider — configure via env vars (see model_config.py).

SETUP:
  1. Clone & install tau2-bench:
       git clone https://github.com/sierra-research/tau2-bench ../tau2-bench
       pip install -e ../tau2-bench

  2. Copy this directory to .capevolve/project/adapters/

  3. Set env vars (in .env or shell):
       MODEL=gpt-4.1-mini  OPENAI_API_KEY=«redacted»       # OpenAI
       MODEL=anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6  ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=«redacted»  # Anthropic
       MODEL=vertex_ai/claude-sonnet-4-6              # Vertex AI (ADC, no key)
       MODEL=ollama/qwen2.5:7b-instruct  API_BASE=http://localhost:11434  # local
       MODEL=litellm_proxy/my-model  LITELLM_PROXY_API_BASE=http://proxy:4000  LITELLM_PROXY_API_KEY=«redacted»

  4. Run: cap-evolve check && cap-evolve run

WHAT THIS OPTIMIZES:
  - The airline domain's system-prompt policy (policy/policy.md)
  - Optionally the tool implementations (tools/tools.py)

HOW IT WORKS:
  - tasks()      → all 50 airline tasks from tau2 (stable, no network).
  - run_batch()  → tau2's own batch runner (run_tasks) with your model.
  - score()      → tau2's own reward in [0,1] with gold-safe feedback.
  - apply()      → overrides the registry's airline env constructor.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import os
import re
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))

from cap_evolve import CapabilityAdapter, Rollout, Score, Task

import model_config

DOMAIN = "airline"

# docs/TAU2_SUMMARY.md row 7: the tau2-bench user simulator sometimes emits ``###STOP###``
